targets.quality_label: Gordan theta 1863 full-audit fix06 with German/English TeX/PDF, 600-ppi source witness, crops, and audit ledgers; working draft/source-audit package only
targets.coverage: Paul Gordan, Ueber die Transformation der Theta-Funktionen, 1863. The package uses the local Google Books/Basel 600-ppi witness as the working source authority, retains the fix05 c^8=1 correction, and adds three fix06 repairs: formula 9 chi^2(a)=varphi'(a) corrected to chi^8(a)=varphi^4(a); odd-gamma reduction first theta argument corrected to gamma omega after the parity term is moved into the second argument; and formula 19 restored with the Gaussian exponential factor inherited from formula 16. German and English PDFs compile to 12 pages each.
targets.limitations: Package README explicitly separates source-faithful corrections, mathematical normalizations, and printed-source typo traps. The formula 19 repair is a mathematical normalization of a printed-source omission rather than a literal transcription. This is not a certified critical edition.
